remarks: Discover this exceptional, cozy abode nestled in a coveted location just a leisurely stroll away from the beach. Boasting its very own charming guest cottage and delightful in-ground pool, this residence offers unparalleled warmth and hospitality, and promises to be a haven of relaxation and entertainment for all who visit. Steeped in history dating back to 1803, and most recently updated in 2015, this residence seamlessly blends old-world charm with contemporary conveniences tailored for today's lifestyle. The main house boasts a gorgeous kitchen, sunken living room with original beams, 2 fplcs, wideboard flooring, four inviting bedrooms and three full baths, accompanied by a picturesque sunroom that offers captivating views of the tranquil pool area. Additionally, the separate cottage features its own full bath, presenting versatile opportunities as an in-law suite, private guest space, a serene home office, a tranquil yoga studio, or an inspiring artist workspace. Experience the epitome of Westport beach living in this unparalleled sanctuary, offering a unique blend of charm, comfort, and convenience. Welcome to your extraordinary new place to call home.
